content.short: DeFiLlama is an open analytics platform for tracking TVL, fees, revenue, volumes, yields, and protocol activity.
content.description: DeFiLlama is a crypto analytics platform best known for total value locked dashboards, but its official pages cover a broader set of chain and protocol metrics. The project describes itself as the largest TVL aggregator for DeFi and emphasizes open-source data, transparent methodology, and community-maintained coverage. Users can compare ecosystems and applications by TVL, fees, revenue, trading volume, bridge activity, and yield opportunities across hundreds of networks. For Mantle users, it is a practical research tool for monitoring ecosystem traction, protocol rankings, and market structure with public data.
